CapturedInvite.visibility: module-private, never exported and never placed in React data
CapturedInvite.shape: { accessToken: string; refreshToken: string; deadlineMs: number }
invariants: accessToken and refreshToken are nonempty ASCII strings of at most 16384 characters with no control or whitespace characters; the provider remains the token validator
deadlineMs is the earlier of capturedAtMs + expires_in * 1000 and expires_at * 1000 when expires_at is present
the value exists only in the one-shot module handoff and then in private CloudAuth fields

dataTypes.CapturedInviteResult: module-private union: { kind: 'none' } | { kind: 'failure'; code: InviteFailureCode } | { kind: 'credentials'; value: CapturedInvite }
dataTypes.InvitePreparationResult: exported safe union: { status: 'password' } | { status: 'failure'; code: InviteFailureCode }
dataTypes.InviteCompletionResult: exported safe union: { status: 'complete' } | { status: 'failure'; code: InviteFailureCode }
dataTypes.InviteScreenState: React-safe union only: 'checking' | 'password' | 'submitting' | 'complete' | InviteFailureCode. It contains no token, subject, email, password, provider text or provider response.

functions.signature: captureInviteUrlBeforeRender(location: Pick<Location, 'pathname' | 'search' | 'hash'>, history: Pick<History, 'state' | 'replaceState'>, capturedAtMs?: number): void
contract: Called synchronously once from main.tsx before createBrowserRouter, createRoot, loadInstallation or any Auth call.

For /auth/invite, copy location.hash to a function-local string, immediately call history.replaceState(history.state, '', location.pathname), then parse the local copy. Any nonempty location.search makes the captured result invite_invalid and is also removed.
For legacy /staff/join, immediately replace the URL with location.pathname and discard both search and fragment without parsing or retaining either value.
For every other pathname, do nothing.
Store only one module-private CapturedInviteResult. A second call never replaces a previously captured result.
If replaceState fails, discard the local fragment, store invite_invalid and throw a fixed token-free bootstrap error before router creation or network.

functions.contract: Zero the module-private handoff. RuntimeBoundary calls it on installation failure before exposing the existing safe installation error.

contract: Claim the one-shot CapturedInviteResult into private CloudAuth fields. No returned value contains credentials or subject.
Return the captured missing, invalid or expired state without creating the Supabase client when credentials are absent or the deadline has passed.
Use CloudAuth.client(), the one existing Supabase client configured with persistSession=false and detectSessionInUrl=false. Do not create a second client.

Read the current memory session. If one exists, validate its access token with provider getUser; separately validate the invitation access token with provider getUser. Compare only those provider-validated user.id values. A current subject different from the invitation subject returns invite_session_conflict without replacing or signing out the existing session.

Call setSession only after that comparison. Require the returned session subject to equal the validated invitation subject and keep invite mode locked so onAuthStateChange cannot publish ready, start inspect, expose getToken or open VerifiedSession.
Do not decode an unverified JWT for identity and do not read or return the Auth email claim in this first-admin seam.
Accept the password only as the call argument. Call sdk.auth.updateUser({ password }) against the prepared invitation session.

After updateUser confirms password success, call Supabase Auth signOut({ scope: 'local' }) on a best-effort basis, then always clear the private invitation credentials, subject and session, stop refresh, abort the Auth lifetime, dispose the client and publish the ordinary signed-out snapshot. Local cleanup and disposal are mandatory even when local signout reports an error.
Never construct BusinessTransport and never call /auth/revoke, /identity/link, /me or any other business API from this callback.

Return complete after confirmed updateUser success and mandatory local cleanup. A local-scope signout error does not change complete to provider_unavailable because the one-shot credentials and session have already been disposed and cannot support a retry.

A provider password-policy 4xx returns password_rejected and keeps the prepared invitation session only for another password submission on the same cleaned page. provider_unavailable is returned only when updateUser itself lacks a confirmed provider result and the retained, unexpired invitation session can safely retry. The password is not retained.

commonRules: The route accepts fragment parameters only. Any query string, duplicate key, empty required value, unknown key, malformed numeric field or mixed success/error set is invite_invalid.
URLSearchParams decoding is permitted only after history.replaceState has removed the source URL.
No parser error includes the raw fragment, key value or provider description.

numericRules: expires_in is an ASCII base-10 positive safe integer with no sign, decimal point or exponent.
expires_at, when present, is an ASCII base-10 positive safe integer with no sign, decimal point or exponent.
expiry: Compute the conservative deadline defined by CapturedInvite.
Check it after capture, before provider validation, before setSession and before updateUser.
A reached deadline is invite_expired. Provider codes otp_expired, invite_not_found and session_expired at any stage are also invite_expired.

error.mapping: otp_expired, invite_not_found or session_expired in error_code maps to invite_expired. Every other well-formed provider error fragment maps to invite_invalid. error and error_description are never displayed, logged or retained.

providerFailureMapping.redaction: Map only stage, numeric status class and allowlisted expiry code. Provider message, response body, URL, token, subject and email never enter BusinessError, InviteScreenState, console or serialization.

routeAndScreenStateMachine.placement: A direct child of the existing RuntimeBoundary and a sibling of PublicJoinBoundary and AuthBoundary. It is not inside AuthBoundary or BusinessShell.
routeAndScreenStateMachine.screen: FirstAdminInviteScreen in apps/client/src/screens/invites.tsx, built only from existing GridContainer/PageTitle/WireCard/WireCallout/WireEmpty/WireError/WireFormField/WireButton and existing CSS classes.
transitions: closed-parser rejection or non-expiry provider 4xx before password -> invite_invalid
local deadline or allowlisted expiry code -> invite_expired
different current and invitation subjects -> invite_session_conflict
password form submit -> password_rejected -> password form remains available for a new uncontrolled value

preparation or updateUser lacks a confirmed provider result while the unexpired invite session remains retained -> provider_unavailable; retry repeats only that failed operation and never reloads credentials from URL. A local-scope signout error after confirmed updateUser success still transitions to complete after mandatory cleanup
formRules: The callback asks only for password and password confirmation. It has no email, name, role or institution input.
Both password inputs are uncontrolled, use autocomplete=new-password, are read with FormData only on submit, are compared locally, and the form is reset before awaiting Auth.
A local mismatch uses the existing password_mismatch message and performs zero provider calls. It is not a seventh callback failure code.

fixedFailureActions.invite_missing: No form. Tell the user to reopen the original invitation email.
fixedFailureActions.invite_invalid: No form. Tell the user that this invitation link cannot be used and to reopen the original invitation email.
fixedFailureActions.invite_expired: No form. Tell the user to ask the installation operator for a new invitation.
fixedFailureActions.invite_session_conflict: No form. Tell the user to finish or sign out the other account, then reopen the original invitation email. Do not sign out the other account automatically.
fixedFailureActions.password_rejected: Keep the form, show fixed password guidance and allow another entry.
fixedFailureActions.provider_unavailable: Show fixed unavailable guidance and a retry action only while the retained invite session is unexpired and preparation or updateUser can safely repeat. Never show it for a local-scope signout error after confirmed password success; that path completes after mandatory cleanup.

success: After confirmed password update, best-effort local-scope signout and mandatory local cleanup, show complete with no business data and no automatic navigation. A local signout error does not reopen the disposed one-shot flow.
Copy: the password is set; wait for the installation operator to finish administrator connection. The login action is labelled for use only after that completion notice.
A later /login visit creates a fresh password session. The callback session is never reused for business access.
